reading.text:
Reading (locked before any Lean is shown) — def LevyStochCalc.Poisson.IsPoissonFiltration

Paper notion. §2: N is a Poisson random measure on ℝ_+ × E with intensity dt⊗ν, and
(F_t) is the usual augmentation of the filtration generated by W, N and an independent F_0;
implicit is that N is an (F_t)-Poisson random measure: (i) adaptedness — for every
measurable A ⊆ E (with ν(A) < ∞) and s ≤ t, N((s,t] × A) (equivalently N on Borel sets of
[0,t] × E) is F_t-measurable; (ii) independence of the future — for every s, the family
{N(B) : B ⊆ (s,∞) × E measurable} is (jointly) independent of F_s. This is what makes Ñ
integrals of predictable integrands martingales, the isometry hold and the compensation
formula hold.

Faithful Lean predicate (on a filtration ℱ and a PRM N): (i) and (ii) for all s ≤ t, all A
(at least those of finite ν-mass, which suffices by σ-finiteness and monotone limits), with
(ii) as independence of the σ-algebra generated by the increments after s (or for each finite
family of disjoint increments jointly) from ℱ_s. Independence of each single increment
separately from ℱ_s is strictly weaker than (ii) in general — that would be a defect unless
compensated by the PRM's own independence (I would check whether the martingale property of
products/sums then still follows; generally joint independence of the future σ-algebra is
what's needed). Requiring the property for sets with ν(A) = ∞ is harmless (N(B) = ∞ a.s.).
It must be satisfiable by the paper's filtration (augmented, generated by W, N, F_0 with the
three independent).

comparison.text:
Comparison — IsPoissonFiltration (LevyStochCalc/Poisson/Filtered.lean:34-43)

Lean (structure, Prop): for a PRM N and a filtration ℱ indexed by ℝ,
(measurable) ∀ t B, B ⊆ (−∞,t] × E measurable → ω ↦ N ω B is ℱ_t-measurable;
(indep_future) ∀ s ≥ 0, ℱ_s is independent (under P) of ⨆_{D ⊆ (s,∞)×E measurable}
σ(ω ↦ N ω D).

Against my reading ((i) adaptedness of counts, (ii) joint independence of the post-s counts
from F_s):
- (i): all measurable regions of (−∞,t] × E, not only rectangles (s,t]×A with finite ν(A) —
  same content (rectangles generate; the stronger form is what the natural filtration gives).
- (ii): independence of ℱ_s from the σ-algebra generated by ALL counts in (s,∞) × E — the
  joint form I required, not the weaker increment-by-increment form.
- Time ℝ: (i) is also required at negative t and for regions reaching negative times; the
  intensity vanishes there, and the paper's filtration (enlJoint, frozen at its time-0 field
  before 0, containing the natural filtration of N) satisfies it — the library proves
  isPoissonFiltration_enlJoint, used in the specs (Sec2Basics RepresentsMart, PaperSolution).
  (ii) only for s ≥ 0: the paper has no negative times.
- Satisfiable: exists_isBrownianFiltration_and_isPoissonFiltration (Driver/Existence.lean) and
  isPoissonFiltration_enlJoint give instances, including the paper's filtration.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Representation choices of IsPoissonFiltration, and why each is harmless:
1. Time indexed by ℝ: adaptedness is required at every real t for every measurable region of
   (−∞,t] × E (negative times included), independence only for s ≥ 0. The intensity is zero at
   negative times and the paper's augmented filtration (frozen before 0) satisfies both fields
   (isPoissonFiltration_enlJoint), so nothing of the paper's setting is excluded.
2. Adaptedness for all measurable regions rather than generating rectangles, and independence
   from the whole future count σ-algebra: these are the standard (F_t)-PRM conditions in their
   strong form, which the paper's filtration (generated by W, N and an independent F_0, then
   augmented) has.

author_review.disagreements:
The author's review, as shown by rv.py author, consists of the review marker only (no reading text, no item-by-item comparison), so there is no stated position of the author to disagree with on substance.
Not recorded there: adaptedness is demanded at every real time, including negative times and
regions reaching them; the paper's filtration meets it (isPoissonFiltration_enlJoint), so this
is a harmless representation choice, but the review should say so.
